---
title: "لوریاں والا بھرا جل گیا اے جھولا تیڈا"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
reciter: "Qurban Jafry"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []

Lorian wala bhira, jal gayai jhoola tenda
Shaam waindi paiyan Asghar veer wey hunr alwida alwida

1
Devan lut da haal kiya raas aayi nahi kerbala

2
1. phul jiya tenda badan, hai jo mohtaj e kafan
Waqt honda bakht honda, kar ke waindi mein dafan
Piyoo wangu tu benava, maa wangu mein be rida

3
2. teer jhul ke sum gaiyan, de ke wakhra ghum gaiyan
Veer malkul mot koon bhi, toon kara matam gaiyan
Waikh rondi rahi kaza, akhri tendi ada

4
3. lori sunr hamsheer ton, ujri maa dilgeer ton
Raj handawain veer shala, veer di jageer toon
Haan khari daindi dua, hath mein rasiyan walay cha

5
4. dekh hath azad nai, jholi bhi abaad nahi
Bhainr te maa kol bachiya, kujh bhi tenday baad nahi
Ujree koon ai taan dasaa, kiwain jeesan tain siwa

6
5. kiya dasaan besheer we, apni mein taqdeer we
Bohoon maikun babay da qatil, jhirkaan daindai veer wey
Hai teri maqtal gawah, kujh bhi nai sada riya

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/lorian-oala-bhra-jl-gaya-ae-jhola-tida.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, labels in [(roman, '123456'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵۶')]:
    groups = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    lines = [[line.strip() for line in group.splitlines()] for group in groups]
    assert [group[0] for group in lines[1:]] == list(labels)
    assert [len(lines[0])] + [len(group)-1 for group in lines[1:]] == [2,1,3,3,3,3,3]
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Both editions contain 18 verse lines across the preamble and six stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the lyric in Saraiki script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The dialect forms *maikun*, *tenda*, and *koon* support the Saraiki classification. Both versions contain 18 verse lines across the preamble and six stanzas.

I used the existing title to resolve *gayai* as `گیا اے` and rendered the less certain *sum gaiyan* as `سُم گئیاں`. Only the selected lyric was edited.
